column1: # renames.tsv — names the kit used before 3.0 (Spanish) and their English replacement. Read by migrate.sh.
# Columns: kind<TAB>old path<TAB>new path (both relative to $HOME). Kinds:
#   shim  kit command or hook: the old file is set aside and a small wrapper that calls the new name is left
#   drop  kit file with no caller of its own (menus, themes, agents…): the old file is set aside
#   data  your data or settings: moved to the new name, never overwritten
# Order matters: a directory is listed before the files inside it.
